title: CONT-11 / WAVE 7 — Kotlin stdlib semantic backend investigation + Compose draw frontier
body:
# CONT-11 / WAVE 7 — Kotlin/stdlib semantic backend investigation + Compose draw frontier

## 0. PURPOSE

Do NOT assume the remaining Dooz/Compose blocker is “just another Kotlin root”.

The latest CONT-10 evidence proves two generic Kotlin/collection semantic failures:
- F-NEW-259: Kotlin `ArrayDeque` inherits Kotlin `AbstractList.iterator()`; MiniAndroid's host/shadow iterator resolved `size()/get()` by name only, so R8-renamed overrides were invisible.
- F-NEW-259b: `java.util.ArrayList.addAll(Collection)` was missing and silently became a no-op.

After those fixes, real Compose navigation materializes multiple LayoutNodes, but drawing still stops before framebuffer because the AndroidCanvas bridge is never constructed.

This wave must answer a larger question before adding many more handwritten roots:

**Can MiniAndroid reuse an existing Kotlin/JVM/stdlib implementation, source-derived compatibility layer, host Java implementation, or other open-source runtime component to cover families of Kotlin collection/runtime semantics generically?**

Do not guess. Research first, then prove the smallest reusable path experimentally.

## 1. BASELINE / CURRENT HEAD

Before changes:
- verify remote main HEAD
- verify binary SHA
- rebuild deterministically
- run CONT-10 baseline
- run Dooz fallback-disabled 3x
- preserve current Dooz anchor and opencalc/chess/microtimer/unote controls
- verify CONT-10 probes 7/7 and negatives 19/19

If HEAD differs from the assumed evidence lineage, reconcile first.

## 2. SOURCE-FIRST KOTLIN FORENSICS

Read the actual upstream sources for the pinned APK versions, not generic web summaries.

Required sources:
- Kotlin stdlib version actually present in target APKs
- `kotlin.collections.AbstractList`
- `kotlin.collections.AbstractCollection`
- `kotlin.collections.ArrayDeque`
- `kotlin.collections.ArrayList`
- Map/Set/HashMap/HashSet/LinkedHashMap/LinkedHashSet
- iterators/list iterators
- Collection/Iterable/Sequence operations
- array-to-collection conversion
- equals/hashCode/toArray contracts
- JVM-specific stdlib actualizations
- kotlinx.coroutines version actually present
- Continuation/CoroutineDispatcher/DispatchedContinuation/EventLoop/Flow/StateFlow/collect semantics

For every candidate, record:
SOURCE -> ALGORITHM -> SEMANTIC LAW -> MiniAndroid implementation path -> current divergence.

## 3. CRITICAL RESEARCH QUESTION — CAN WE REUSE INSTEAD OF REIMPLEMENT?

Investigate at least these reuse strategies:

### A. Execute the APK's own Kotlin stdlib DEX correctly
Determine whether the current engine already has enough infrastructure that fixing generic:
- virtual/interface dispatch
- inherited method lookup
- descriptor-slot resolution
- property getter/setter dispatch
- collection copy semantics
- array/object/primitive kind preservation
- iterator contracts
could make most Kotlin stdlib work without a separate Kotlin backend.

This is the preferred hypothesis if source evidence supports it.

### B. Reuse Kotlin/JVM stdlib source or compiled implementation
Investigate whether upstream Kotlin/JVM stdlib source or `kotlin-stdlib.jar` can be reused as a semantic reference/backend.

Do NOT simply execute host JVM objects in place of guest DEX objects unless object identity, class identity, field identity, generic dispatch, exceptions, and guest/host boundary semantics are proven equivalent.

Determine exactly what is reusable:
- source algorithms
- compiled bytecode
- Java collection delegation
- tests/conformance corpus
- selected helper algorithms
- generated/native helper code

### C. Host Java/OpenJDK collection backend
Investigate whether Kotlin/JVM's Java collection paths delegate to `java.util.*` and whether MiniAndroid can safely reuse OpenJDK semantics for selected operations.

OpenJDK `ArrayList.addAll` is a useful reference, but do not blindly substitute host objects.

Required decision:
DIRECT REUSE / ADAPTER / SOURCE-PORT / CURRENT DEX EXECUTION / NOT SAFE.

### D. Existing open-source JVM/DEX runtimes
Search GitHub for reusable execution engines/components:
- DEX interpreters
- Dalvik/ART-compatible interpreters
- JVM bytecode interpreters
- lightweight JVMs
- Kotlin/JVM runtime implementations
- Android compatibility runtimes
- collection/stdlib semantic test suites

Prioritize local/CPU/open-source/no-server/no-GPU projects.

Explicitly inspect relevant projects such as AndroidRecomp, DroidVM, Skydnir, droidsaw and any stronger DEX/JVM runtime you discover. Do not force unrelated projects into the solution: classify each as REUSABLE / REFERENCE-ONLY / IRRELEVANT.

### E. Kotlin coroutines reuse
Separate this from collections.

Investigate whether `kotlinx.coroutines` source/compiled runtime can be executed unchanged by MiniAndroid once generic dispatch/thread/event-loop/continuation semantics are correct.

Do NOT replace coroutines with fake immediate execution.

## 4. BUILD A KOTLIN SEMANTIC COVERAGE MATRIX

Mine representative APKs and the current corpus.

At minimum classify:
- ArrayList
- ArrayDeque
- LinkedList
- HashMap
- LinkedHashMap
- HashSet
- LinkedHashSet
- Collections.unmodifiable/singleton/empty
- MutableCollection/MutableList defaults
- iterator/listIterator
- add/addAll/removeAll/retainAll
- contains/containsAll
- filter/map/flatMap
- first/last/lastOrNull
- sequence operations
- toArray
- equals/hashCode
- ranges/indices
- Pair/Triple
- lazy/delegates
- Result/Unit/Intrinsics
- Function/Lambda/SAM bridges
- suspend Continuation
- CoroutineDispatcher
- DispatchedContinuation
- EventLoop
- Flow/StateFlow
- cancellation
- delay/scheduling

For each:
CURRENTLY EXECUTES / PARTIAL / SILENT-NO-OP / WRONG / MISSING / BLOCKED.

Do not create one root per method. Collapse by semantic law.

## 5. RESEARCH THE CURRENT F-NEW-259/F-NEW-259b FIXES FOR GENERALITY

Audit the actual implementation added in CONT-10.

Prove whether:
- descriptor-slot fallback is truly generic for inherited R8-renamed overrides
- it works for non-collection classes
- it works for multiple inheritance/interface/default-method shapes
- bounded superclass walking is semantically correct
- it cannot select the wrong override
- it preserves declaring-class identity
- it works for primitive/boxed/array return types
- addAll copy preserves STRING/INT/OBJECT/ARRAY kinds
- addAll works guest->guest and guest->host/shadow boundaries without identity loss

Create focused positive and negative probes.

If the mechanism itself is the real reusable Kotlin solution, prefer extending that generic mechanism over adding a “Kotlin backend”.

## 6. CURRENT FIRST DIVERGENCE — ANDROIDCANVAS

After CONT-10 fixes, trace the remaining Dooz path:

NavHost
-> LayoutNode tree
-> measure
-> layout
-> layer/drawContent
-> AndroidCanvas bridge
-> Canvas operations
-> Surface/buffer
-> framebuffer

Find the FIRST point where upstream Compose 1.11.4 behavior differs.

Required:
- exact upstream source method
- exact R8-mapped MiniAndroid method/class
- entry/exit trace
- receiver identity
- arguments
- return value
- state before/after
- why AndroidCanvas is not constructed
- whether the cause is Kotlin collection/runtime, Compose runtime, Android graphics bridge, or dispatch/reflection.

Do not patch Canvas merely to produce pixels.

## 7. DO NOT REPEAT THE OLD FALSE ROOTS

Explicitly test and rule out:
- “ComposableLambda is never reinvoked”
- LifecycleRegistry as the current blocker
- ViewTreeLifecycleOwner missing
- coroutine parent=0
- instruction budget too small
- Dooz-specific R8 class names
- hardcoded fallback rendering

The latest CONT-10 evidence already corrected the first three historical interpretations.

## 8. REAL APK FAN-OUT

Use:
1. Dooz original APK, fallback disabled
2. Sudoku/SudokuSolver Compose APK
3. one additional independent Compose APK
4. one non-Compose Kotlin/R8 app
5. one Kotlin-heavy game/app from the corpus

For each:
APK SHA
ABI/preflight
Kotlin version
Compose/coroutines versions if present
first divergence
semantic cluster
before/after
3 clean runs
pixel/state evidence.

A fix is not generic unless an independent consumer benefits.

## 9. KOTLIN REUSE DECISION

Produce a hard decision matrix:

| Candidate | What is reusable | Integration point | Guest identity safe? | R8 safe? | Generic? | License | CPU/local | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Possible verdicts:
- USE DIRECTLY
- USE THROUGH ADAPTER
- PORT SOURCE ALGORITHMS
- USE AS CONFORMANCE ORACLE
- REFERENCE ONLY
- REJECT

Do not introduce a large external runtime unless evidence shows it is smaller and safer than fixing MiniAndroid's existing generic execution semantics.

## 10. REQUIRED TEST ARTIFACTS

Create focused probes for:
- inherited R8-renamed collection iterator
- addAll for empty/non-empty
- addAll order preservation
- primitive/string/object/array element fidelity
- HashMap/HashSet iteration
- LinkedHashMap order
- ArrayDeque wrap-around
- iterator mutation/termination
- nested inherited dispatch
- coroutine continuation resume
- dispatcher no-dispatch/immediate path
- Flow/StateFlow emission and conflation
- delay/event-loop scheduling

Each must have positive + negative cases.

## 11. REGRESSION

After every generic fix:
- synthetic probe
- target real APK
- independent app/game
- anchors 5/5 x3
- negatives 19/19
- skill 13/13
- relevant CONT-10 probes
- Dooz 3x
- no hidden fallback.

## 12. EVIDENCE / AUDIT CHECKLIST

Update the consolidated ledger line-by-line:

- [ ] upstream Kotlin source read
- [ ] Kotlin version pinned
- [ ] JVM stdlib source read
- [ ] OpenJDK reference read
- [ ] coroutines source read
- [ ] existing runtime/tool candidates searched
- [ ] reusable components classified
- [ ] current implementation audited
- [ ] semantic clusters formed
- [ ] synthetic positive
- [ ] synthetic negative
- [ ] real APK
- [ ] independent consumer
- [ ] 3-run
- [ ] regression
- [ ] first divergence
- [ ] evidence artifact
- [ ] registry overlap checked
- [ ] no app-specific patch
- [ ] no bulk registry inflation

Use statuses:
IMPLEMENTED / TESTED / OBSERVED / PARTIAL / BLOCKED / PENDING / SUPERSEDED.

## 13. DEFINITION OF DONE

Do not stop at “Kotlin root found”.

Done requires:
1. A source-backed decision on whether a reusable Kotlin/JVM/stdlib backend is technically viable.
2. A source-backed decision on whether current MiniAndroid generic dispatch/collection semantics are the better reuse mechanism.
3. At least one high-ROI generic Kotlin semantic improvement proven on a real APK.
4. Current Dooz first draw divergence identified precisely.
5. At least one independent consumer benefits, or exact external prerequisite is proven.
6. No host-object substitution that breaks guest identity.
7. No Kotlin-name/R8-name allow-list.
8. No fake coroutine execution.
9. No fallback pixels counted as compatibility.
10. All evidence committed and pushed.

## FINAL REPORT

### F. NEXT SINGLE HIGHEST-ROI ROOT
State one root only, with source + runtime evidence.

NO-GO:
- no app-specific Kotlin patches
- no R8-name tables
- no fake coroutine scheduler
- no host object identity substitution without proof
- no hardcoded Compose pixels
- no budget inflation
- no bulk external-KB root import
